title: pkix-ct Error missing serde feature parity
description:
pkix-ct::Error derives `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash` but has NO `#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]` attribute, despite the crate having a `serde` Cargo feature (`dep:serde` + `dep:serde_json` + `dep:base64` behind `log-list-json`). Every other crate in the core path-validation stack (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-path-builder, pkix-identity, pkix-aia, pkix-truststore, pkix-zlint-bridge) gates serde derives on a `serde` feature, meeting AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 ('result/error types ... SHOULD support serde::Serialize + Deserialize behind a serde feature flag for cross-process / persistent caches').

pkix-ct::Error does not. The crate has `serde` as a dependency (for `log-list-json`) but does not expose it as a standalone feature gating Error derives.

Impact: callers caching CT verification failures across processes cannot serde-roundtrip pkix_ct::Error the way they can with every other workspace error type. This breaks the uniformity callers depend on when building a generic cache over `impl serde::Serialize` error values.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ct/src/lib.rs line 67-69
